terms.gloss: in public, in the street, out of doors
evidence: Liv. 34.2.10: in pūblicō quam in prīvātō (Lewis & Short s.v. blandus)
Cic. Quinct. 61: dēprehendis in pūblicō (Lewis & Short s.v. abdūcō)
terms.comment: Opposed to in prīvātō, at home, in private.

terms.gloss: out of doors, abroad; in public life
evidence: Cic. Arch. 16: haec studia dēlectant domī, nōn impediunt forīs, “in public life” (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Out of the house, as against domī: in public life, or simply outside.

sources: Lewis & Short: publicus · Lewis & Short: foris
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 106, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
